title: Joomla Variables
description: Configuration variables for deploying and serving the Joomla CMS web application.

JOOMLA_VERSION.description: Target Joomla CMS release version or semantic alias (e.g., latest) to install.

JOOMLA_DB_PASS.description: Database password used by Joomla to authenticate against its relational database.

JOOMLA_PHP_FPM_LISTEN.description: PHP-FPM upstream FastCGI socket path or host:port endpoint serving Joomla requests.

JOOMLA_LISTEN.description: HTTP bind address:port or UNIX socket endpoint exposed by the Joomla web server.

JOOMLA_DB_TYPE.description: Database driver backend for Joomla (e.g., mysqli, pgsql, mysql).

JOOMLA_WEBSERVER.description: Frontend web server component fronting Joomla (e.g., nginx, caddy, httpd).

JOOMLA_WWWROOT.description: Filesystem document root directory where Joomla source files are deployed.

JOOMLA_DB_USER.description: Database role or username granted ownership of the Joomla schema.

JOOMLA_SERVER_NAME.description: Virtual host domain or server_name configured for Joomla HTTP/TLS routing.

JOOMLA_DB_NAME.description: Relational database name provisioned for Joomla content and metadata.
